declined.specs: Three open roadmap items, none longer than one row. A tasks/ directory would hold nothing today, and an empty one invites entries that are really change notes. Re-open when a roadmap row grows past three paragraphs.

notes.skills: The skill-placement block names skills/<name>/ as the source and .claude/skills/ as a generated runtime view. No such generation step exists for project-owned skills in any repo here, so the block was composed with .claude/skills/<name>/ as the home. See DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-06.
notes.check-docs: tools/check-docs.sh is copied unchanged from the standards repo and reads this file for the module selection. Project exceptions live in tools/check-docs.allow. It runs from the verify skill; no pre-commit hook and no CI job yet.
